title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 7: the young man without understanding and the woman who leads him astray with flattering words.

questions.text: How should the son guard the father's teaching?
questions.explanation: The verse says: "Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye."

answers.text: As a treasure in the field
As the apple of your eye
As a lamp in the night
As a ring on your hand

questions.text: What should you tell wisdom, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says: "Tell wisdom, 'You are my sister.' Call understanding your relative."

questions.text: From where did the speaker look out and see the young man void of understanding?
questions.explanation: The speaker says: "At the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice" and saw the young man.

answers.text: From the gate at the entry of the city
From the rooftop of his neighbor's house
From a seat in the high places of the city
Through the lattice at the window of his house

questions.text: In what attire did the woman meet the young man?
questions.explanation: A woman met him with the attire of a prostitute and with crafty intent.

questions.text: What does the woman say she has done "today"?
questions.explanation: She says: "Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows."

answers.text: Sold her goods at the market

questions.text: With what has the woman perfumed her bed?
questions.explanation: She says: "I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon."

questions.text: When does the woman say her husband will come home?
questions.explanation: She says her husband has gone on a long journey with a bag of money and will come home at the full moon.

questions.text: The young man follows her immediately, like which animal going to the slaughter?
questions.explanation: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

questions.text: What is said about those the woman has slain?
questions.explanation: She has thrown down many wounded; yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

answers.text: All her slain are a mighty army
They are more than the stars
They are buried outside the city

questions.text: What is her house called at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
